appDescription.message: Control Spotify Web from the side panel or an optional floating widget.

welcomeBody.message: Control Spotify Web from Firefox's sidebar or an optional floating widget.

privacyBody.message: No TuneDock account, no server and no personal data collection. Preferences stay in Firefox.

officialSpotifyHelp.message: Spotify opens on its official website.

openSpotifyToStart.message: Open Spotify Web to get started

startMusicSpotify.message: Start playing music in Spotify Web

notAffiliated.message: TuneDock is independent and not affiliated with Spotify.

widgetPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied: the widget remains disabled.

previousUnavailable.message: Previous track is unavailable for the current Spotify playback.

nextUnavailable.message: Next track is unavailable for the current Spotify playback.

shuffleUnavailable.message: Shuffle is unavailable for the current Spotify playback or account.

repeatUnavailable.message: Repeat is unavailable for the current Spotify playback or account.

devicesUnavailable.message: Spotify's device selector could not be found.

favoriteUnavailable.message: The Liked Songs button could not be found in Spotify Web.

volumeUnavailable.message: Volume is unavailable in Spotify Web.

spotifyStartupTimeout.message: Spotify Web is taking too long to start.

spotifyNotResponding.message: Spotify Web is not responding. Open Spotify and try again.

languageHelp.message: By default, TuneDock automatically follows Firefox's language.

feedbackBody.message: A rating or report helps improve future versions.

advancedPrivacy.message: Preferences are stored only in Firefox. TuneDock does not collect personal data.

privacyNotice.message: TuneDock does not collect, sell or share personal data. It has no server, advertising or analytics.

privacyLocalBody.message: TuneDock reads visible Spotify Web player information — title, artist, artwork, playback, position, volume and control status — only to display and control playback requested by the user.

privacyStorageBody.message: Preferences, widget position and onboarding status are stored locally in the Firefox profile. No Spotify identifier, password or OAuth token is stored.

privacyWidgetBody.message: HTTPS page access is requested only when the user enables the widget. The widget does not read page content, forms or browsing history; it only displays TuneDock controls.

privacyThirdBody.message: TuneDock communicates only with Spotify Web over HTTPS to perform requested actions. Spotify use remains subject to Spotify's terms.

privacyLyricsBody.message: After an explicit click, TuneDock can open a Google search containing the title and artist. TuneDock does not contact Google in the background, retrieve results, store or reproduce lyrics.
